article_title: King praises Strait of Hormuz peace efforts at glittering banquet

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the state visit described in the article?
options: To honour the Sultan of Oman while strengthening diplomatic, security and economic ties during Middle East tensions
To announce that Oman will join the United Kingdom
To celebrate the reopening of every shipping route in the Gulf
To transfer Windsor Castle to the Omani royal family
tasks.correct_answer: To honour the Sultan of Oman while strengthening diplomatic, security and economic ties during Middle East tensions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביקור משלב טקסיות מלכותית עם מאמצים לחזק קשרים מדיניים, ביטחוניים וכלכליים על רקע המלחמה והמתיחות באזור.

tasks.prompt: What did King Charles praise Oman for in his banquet speech?
options: Building a new royal palace in London
Trying to keep the Strait of Hormuz open and mediating in the conflict with Iran
Ending all trade with the United States
Creating the banquet menu at Windsor
tasks.correct_answer: Trying to keep the Strait of Hormuz open and mediating in the conflict with Iran
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המלך שיבח את מאמצי עומאן לשמור את נתיב השיט החשוב פתוח ואת התיווך הדיפלומטי שלה במלחמה עם איראן.

tasks.prompt: What does “mediation” mean in the article's diplomatic context?
options: A military attack intended to end negotiations
A formal royal celebration
An effort by a third party to help opponents reach agreement
A decision to close a shipping lane
tasks.correct_answer: An effort by a third party to help opponents reach agreement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: mediation היא תיווך: צד שלישי מסייע לצדדים יריבים למצוא מכנה משותף או פתרון מוסכם.

tasks.prompt: What deal are the Sultan and the UK prime minister expected to sign?
options: A treaty transferring control of the Strait to Britain
A ban on investment between the two countries
An agreement to replace diplomatic talks with military action
A plan to accelerate mutual investment expected to bring more than £1bn of new investment
tasks.correct_answer: A plan to accelerate mutual investment expected to bring more than £1bn of new investment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העסקה אמורה להאיץ השקעות הדדיות, ולפי משרד החוץ להביא יותר ממיליארד ליש״ט בהשקעות חדשות וליצור משרות והזדמנויות.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article describe state visits as a mix of “pageantry and politics”?
options: Elaborate ceremonies create a setting for serious talks on diplomacy, business and military links.
Royal banquets replace all official government negotiations.
Political leaders attend only to inspect table decorations.
Pageantry prevents countries from discussing sensitive issues.
tasks.correct_answer: Elaborate ceremonies create a setting for serious talks on diplomacy, business and military links.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הטקסים, הכרכרות והמשתה הם החלק הייצוגי, אך הם גם מספקים מסגרת לשיחות מעשיות על יחסים מדיניים, מסחר וביטחון.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “bridge building in a time of conflict”, what does “bridge building” mean?
options: Constructing a road across the Strait of Hormuz
Decorating Windsor Castle for a state visit
Improving relationships and communication between opposing sides
Expanding Oman's shipping ports
tasks.correct_answer: Improving relationships and communication between opposing sides
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bridge building משמש כמטפורה ליצירת קשר, אמון ודיאלוג בין צדדים הנמצאים במחלוקת או בעימות.

tasks.prompt: Give three details showing the ceremony and hospitality of the Windsor banquet.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים קונקרטיים מהכתבה על האורחים, השולחן, התפריט, השפות, העיטורים או התאמות לאורחים המוסלמים.
expected_points: The banquet was held for 160 guests in St George's Hall.
The King spoke in English and included quotations in Arabic.
The tables had elaborate candelabra, five glasses per setting and salt imprinted with the King's cypher.
The menu included pheasant, Cornish crab and baked Alaska.
A non-alcoholic spiced coffee drink replaced the traditional banquet cocktail for the Muslim guests of honour.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the visit connects royal ceremony with Oman's strategic importance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את קבלת הפנים והמשתה עם מיקום עומאן ליד המצר, תפקידה בתיווך, הקשרים הביטחוניים־מסחריים והעסקה הצפויה.
expected_points: The Sultan received a formal royal welcome, carriage procession and state banquet at Windsor.
Oman lies beside the strategically important Strait of Hormuz, which has been effectively closed during the war.
The King highlighted Oman's mediation and efforts to find common ground with Iran.
The visit also supports talks on business and military links and a planned investment deal.

tasks.prompt: Why was the banquet cocktail replaced, even though wine was still available?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק שהמארחים התאימו מסורת מלכותית לאורחי הכבוד המוסלמים תוך שמירה על יתר מרכיבי האירוח; אין לטעון שהכתבה אומרת שכל האורחים נמנעו מאלכוהול.
expected_points: The guests of honour were Muslim.
The hosts adapted a traditional element by serving a non-alcoholic spiced coffee drink.
Wine remained available, so the change was a targeted gesture of cultural consideration rather than a complete alcohol ban.

tasks.prompt: Write a short diplomatic report using the words “mediation”, “tensions” and “investment”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלוש המילים במדויק ולחבר בין המצב במזרח התיכון, תפקידה של עומאן והיעד הכלכלי של הביקור.
expected_points: Use all three required words accurately.
Mention Oman's mediation and efforts to keep dialogue open.
Refer to regional tensions around Iran and the Strait of Hormuz.
Explain that the visit is expected to support more than £1bn in mutual investment.
